lines.en: label ayanedorm15:
: Hey, Ayane. Are you-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ayane。你是——

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux1
: ...free?
lines.zh: : ……有空吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? What a crazy coincidence! I totally haven't been jumping out of my chair every time I heard footsteps in the hall at all.
lines.zh: : 老师？多疯狂的巧合啊！我可完全没在每次听见走廊有脚步声就从椅子上蹦起来。

lines.en: : Well, how lucky of me to have shown up the one time you decided to do that.
lines.zh: : 那我运气真好，正好赶上你唯一一次决定不那么做。

lines.en: : I'll wait until you finish speaking to open the door next time.
lines.zh: : 下次我等你把话说完再开门。

lines.en: : I appreciate that. But anyway, do you want to hang out and maybe get some of that obsessive, slightly overbearing energy out of your system?
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过话说回来，要不要一起待会儿，把你那股 obsessive、稍微有点压迫感的精力发散掉一些？

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux2
: Heck yeah I do! And for future reference, you don't even need to ask! I {i}always{/i} want to hang out.
lines.zh: : 当然想啊！顺便说一句，以后你连问都不用问！我{i}随时{/i}都想跟你待在一起。

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux3
: The only thing is that we can't really hang out {i}here{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，这次我们没法在{i}这儿{/i}待。

lines.en: : Did your air conditioner break or something?
lines.zh: : 你空调坏了还是怎么的？

lines.en: if day != 5:
: Huh? No, it’s nothing like that. Sana just fell asleep early.
lines.zh: : 哈？不是，不是那么回事。Sana 只是早早睡着了。

lines.en: else:
: Huh? No, that’s not it. I’ve just been cooped up in there for too long and I want to get some air.
lines.zh: : 哈？不，也不是那个。我只是在里面闷太久了，想出去透透气。

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux1
: Did you want to maybe go for a walk with me, though? We don't normally do stuff at night and I want to know how it feels to go adventuring alongside my future husband.
lines.zh: : 不过你要不要跟我出去走走？我们平时晚上都不怎么出门，而我想知道跟未来的丈夫一起冒险是什么感觉。

lines.en: : I will agree only if you stop calling me that.
lines.zh: : 只要你别再那么叫我，我就答应。

lines.en: : That's fine. I guess we can just hang out in the hall instead.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。我想我们就在走廊里待着也行。

lines.en: : I just sure hope nobody hears all of the intimate details I am going to loudly bring up in conversation.
lines.zh: : 我只希望没人听到我打算大声聊出来的那些私密细节。

lines.en: : Okay then. I guess we're going out after all.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。看来我们终究还是要出去。

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux4
: Yay! I only needed one threat!
lines.zh: : 耶！我只用威胁一次就搞定了！

lines.en: : Just try not to bring up any of those {i}intimate details{/i} outside either. I'm sure it looks bad enough for someone my age to be escorting a school girl in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 只是尽量在外面也别提那些{i}私密细节{/i}。我相信，像我这个年纪的人半夜护送一个女学生，看上去已经够糟了。

lines.en: : The last thing I need is those people also hearing...whatever sort of stuff you planned on sharing.
lines.zh: : 我最不需要的，就是那些人再听见……你打算分享的那些玩意儿。

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux5
: Got it. I'll be on my best behavior.
lines.zh: : 明白。我会表现得最乖。

lines.en: : Can you maybe be on someone else's best behavior instead? Because yours is still a little much at times.
lines.zh: : 你能不能换成别人的「最乖」？因为你的最乖有时候还是有点过。

lines.en: scene firstwordsredux6
: Hey! Have some more faith in me! I haven't even tried dragging you into a dark alley yet!
lines.zh: : 嘿！对我多点信心嘛！我都还没试着把你拖进黑巷子里呢！

lines.en: : Do you see now why I asked you to behave?
lines.zh: : 现在明白我为什么叫你规矩点了吗？

lines.en: : Because you hate fun but you love {i}me{/i} and want to make sure that nothing complicates our already complicated relationship?
lines.zh: : 因为你讨厌好玩的东西，但你爱{i}我{/i}，想确保没有什么会让咱们本就复杂的关系更复杂？

lines.en: : Yes? No?
lines.zh: : 是？不是？

lines.en: scene black
: Let's just go.
lines.zh: : 走吧。

lines.en: Ayane and I leave the dorms together and walk a few blocks down the street to an area with a few local businesses- all of which have already closed down for the night.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我一起离开宿舍，沿街走了几个街区，到了一片有些本地商铺的区域——它们全都已经打烊了。

lines.en: Thankfully, the dorms are located in one of the nicer parts of town, so we're able to move around without ever feeling unwelcome or unsafe.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，宿舍位于镇上比较好的地段，所以我们走动时从没感到不受欢迎或者不安全。

lines.en: Not that I have much to fear being one of just several males in a world that, at least to me, is full of pretty much all small girls.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我自己有什么好怕的——作为这个世界里仅有的几个男性之一，而这个世界至少在我看来几乎全是小女孩。

lines.en: For Ayane's sake, though, I'm glad.
lines.zh: 不过为了 Ayane，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: Despite how much she annoys me at times, I'd really prefer to keep her alive.
lines.zh: 尽管她有时候挺烦人，我是真希望她能活着。

lines.en: Because not only am I enjoying her presence the more time I spend with her-
lines.zh: 因为不光是我跟她待得越久、就越享受她在身边——

lines.en: But she is very fun to have sex with, and I would like to continue doing that.
lines.zh: 而且跟她做爱非常有趣，而我想继续做下去。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk1
: ...and so I told the cashier, ‘I don’t care what the limit is! I’m buying them all!’
lines.zh: : ……于是我跟收银员说，『我不在乎限购多少！我全买了！』

lines.en: : What are you going to do with that many hermit crabs?
lines.zh: : 你要那么多寄居蟹干什么？

lines.en: : I don't know. That's a problem for future Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。那是未来 Ayane 的问题。

lines.en: : I'll probably just keep them all in my room back at home and ask my butler to look after them.
lines.zh: : 我大概会把它们全养在家里的房间，让我的管家照顾。

lines.en: : Did you know that he has a PhD in neuroscience?
lines.zh: : 你知道他有神经科学博士学位吗？

lines.en: : Then why exactly is he a butler?...And what does that have to do with hermit crabs?
lines.zh: : 那他到底为什么当管家？……还有这跟寄居蟹有什么关系？

lines.en: scene ayanewalk2
: Beats me, but I'm glad he's around since I have no idea how I would have survived these last few years without him.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道，不过我很高兴他在，因为真不知道没有他我这几年怎么活过来。

lines.en: : Have things really been that tough over there?
lines.zh: : 那边日子真有那么难？

lines.en: : They've been things. Let's talk more about hermit crabs.
lines.zh: : 发生过一些事。我们还是多聊聊寄居蟹吧。

lines.en: : I'm running out of hermit crab related banter, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我快没寄居蟹相关的俏皮话了，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk3
: Then I guess we'll just have to talk about how much we love each other.
lines.zh: : 那我想我们只好聊聊我们有多爱彼此了。

lines.en: Keeping up with Ayane in conversations is always a bit of a struggle.
lines.zh: 跟 Ayane 对话总是有点吃力。

lines.en: I don't want to say something like {i}she's not normal{/i} when, underneath it all, I think she kind of is.
lines.zh: 我不想说什么「{i}她不正常{/i}」——因为剥开来看，我觉得她其实挺正常的。

lines.en: It can just be a little exhausting trying to make sense of her train of thought when mine is constantly running way behind schedule.
lines.zh: 只是在我的思路常年严重晚点的情况下，要去理顺她的思路，有时候确实有点累。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk3r
: So, joking aside, how do you like this part of town?
lines.zh: : 那么，玩笑放一边，你觉得这一带怎么样？

lines.en: : You've been spending a lot more time over here lately, so you've got to have at least {i}some{/i} sort of opinion on it, right?
lines.zh: : 你最近在这儿待的时间多多了，所以至少该{i}有点{/i}看法吧？

lines.en: : It's...fine, I guess. Most of my time over here is spent inside of your room, though.
lines.zh: : 还……行吧，我想。不过我在这儿的大部分时间都待在你房间里。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk4
: Well, {i}I{/i} like it here a lot.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}很喜欢这儿。

lines.en: : And it might sound a little weird saying this at my age, but I don't think I'd mind spending the rest of my life here if it really came down to it.
lines.zh: : 而且在我这个年纪说这个可能有点怪，不过如果真到了那一步，我想我不会介意在这儿过完余生。

lines.en: : Kumon-mi is kind of like the perfect city, isn't it? New things are always popping up...the weather is always great...and there's this huge sense of community since no one can leave or enter anymore.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 有点像完美的城市，不是吗？新东西总是不断冒出来……天气总是很好……而且因为再也没人能进出，有很强的共同体感。

lines.en: : Do you have a problem with people from other cities or something?
lines.zh: : 你对别的城市来的人有意见还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene ayanewalk3
: Of course not. I love everyone equally. And besides, Maya comes from outside of Kumon-mi and I'm with her basically every day.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我平等地爱所有人。再说，Maya 就是从 Kumon-mi 外面来的，而我基本上每天都跟她在一起。

lines.en: : I just like how we're all kind of...part of something, you know?
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢我们都有点……是某个东西的一部分，你知道吧？

lines.en: : This is where I was born.
lines.zh: : 这是我出生的地方。

lines.en: : It's where I met you.
lines.zh: : 也是我遇见你的地方。

lines.en: : That alone is enough to make me want to stay here forever.
lines.zh: : 光是这一点，就足够让我想永远留在这儿了。

lines.en: We keep walking as the night grows darker and an abundance of clouds begin to appear.
lines.zh: 我们继续走着，夜色渐深，大片云开始出现。

lines.en: I doubt it will rain since that's just...not a thing I've ever seen around here, but I guess my subconscious disagrees as my own set of clouds begins to take shape within my stomach.
lines.zh: 我怀疑不会下雨——因为那根本就是……我在这儿从没见过的事——不过我的潜意识似乎不同意，因为我胃里也开始成形出属于我自己的那团云。

lines.en: A gust of wind attacks us and I catch a whiff of some sort of flowery fragrance Ayane is wearing.
lines.zh: 一阵风扑过来，我闻到 Ayane 身上某种花香。

lines.en: I can't pinpoint it, but it has a sort of calming effect that makes me feel like I'm being wrapped in an oversized blanket.
lines.zh: 我说不准是什么，但它有种让人平静的效果，让我觉得自己被裹进了一条超大号的毯子里。

lines.en: The problem with this is that it's the middle of summer-
lines.zh: 问题在于，现在是盛夏——

lines.en: And this is one of the very few occasions where I would prefer not to be touched.
lines.zh: 而这正是我为数不多宁愿不被碰的时候。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk5
: Can I ask you a really random question?
lines.zh: : 我能问个很随机的问题吗？

lines.en: : {i}How{/i} random, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体{i}有多{/i}随机？

lines.en: : Do you remember what your first words were?
lines.zh: : 你还记得你说的第一句话是什么吗？

lines.en: : Like, from when I was a baby? Of course not. There's no way I'd remember something like that.
lines.zh: : 像我小时候那种？当然不记得。那种事我不可能记得住。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}you{/i} wouldn't, but your parents probably would.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}你{/i}记不住，但你父母大概记得。

lines.en: : I've never heard Ami mention grandparents, though, so I guess finding out might not be possible...
lines.zh: : 不过我从没听 Ami 提过祖父母，所以我想大概查不到了……

lines.en: : If I had to guess, though...I’d say your first word was ‘Mama.’
lines.zh: : 不过如果非要我猜……我会说你的第一个词是「妈妈」。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Maybe because...you’re so good with girls?
lines.zh: : 也许因为……你这么会应付女孩？

lines.en: : That might be true now, but I can't imagine I was this good with them when I was a baby.
lines.zh: : 现在也许是真的，可我想象不出我当婴儿的时候就有这么会。

lines.en: : That's a good point. You've gotta remember that this is just a hunch, though. I am more than willing to accept defeat if you are able to confirm it was something else.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过你得记住这只是直觉。要是你能确认是别的什么，我完全认输。

lines.en: : How about you, then? What were your first words?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？你的第一句话是什么？

lines.en: : You're good with me for the most part. So working off of your logic, wouldn't that mean yours would be like, {i}Dada{/i} or {i}Daddy{/i} or something?
lines.zh: : 你跟我之间大体上是很会的。所以按你的逻辑推，你的第一个词会不会是「{i}爸爸{/i}」之类的？

lines.en: scene ayanewalk6
Ayane becomes uncharacteristically quiet and I immediately recall her mentioning something about the slowly dissipating relationship between her and her father.
lines.zh: Ayane 一反常态地安静下来，我立刻想起她提过她和她父亲之间正在慢慢消散的关系。

lines.en: I don't think she worded it as eloquently as that, but given this reaction, I doubt I'm far off from the truth.
lines.zh: 我想她当时措辞没那么文雅，不过看这反应，我怀疑我离真相不远了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah...I'm pretty sure that...was my first word.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我挺确定……那就是我说的第一个词。

lines.en: : We can talk about something else now, if you want. I should have thought before saying that.
lines.zh: : 你要是想，我们现在可以聊点别的。那句话我该想清楚再说的。

lines.en: scene ayanewalk1
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about me. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 哦，你不用担心我。我没事。

lines.en: : Just...a little nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 只是……有点怀旧。

lines.en: : But it'll pass.
lines.zh: : 不过会过去的。

lines.en: : In the meantime, though, do you think that we can maybe stop at a convenience store or something?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你觉得我们能不能顺便去趟便利店什么的？

lines.en: : I’m still banned from a few of them, but I'm pretty sure there’s one close to here that we can still buy stuff from.
lines.zh: : 我有几家还被禁入，不过我挺确定这附近还有一家我们可以买东西。

lines.en: : What exactly did you do to get banned from so many convenience stores?
lines.zh: : 你到底干了什么，被那么多便利店禁入？

lines.en: scene ayanewalk7
: That's for me to know and you to never find out!
lines.zh: : 那是我该知道、而你永远别想知道的事！

lines.en: scene black
Ayane and I wind up walking around for an hour or two before I bring her back to the dorm.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我最后逛了一两个小时，我才把她送回宿舍。

lines.en: She was perfectly fine for the rest of our outing, so I guess the whole thing with her dad wasn’t as big of an issue as it may have seemed at first.
lines.zh: 我们剩下的行程里她完全没事，所以我想她爸爸那件事，并没有一开始看起来那么严重。

lines.en: That’s good.
lines.zh: 那就好。

lines.en: I’m not sure how I’d handle seeing Ayane as anything but...{i}Ayane.{/i}
lines.zh: 我不确定自己能不能承受 Ayane 变成不是……{i}Ayane{/i} 的样子。

lines.en: So I'll just...keep trying to avoid that line of questioning for as long as I can.
lines.zh: 所以我会……尽量长久地回避那条提问线。

lines.en: Change is scary, even if it's only temporary.
lines.zh: 改变是可怕的，哪怕只是暂时的。

lines.en: So I'll do everything in my power to change absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 所以我会尽我所能，什么都不去改变。

lines.en: And continue to absorb this brand new life- impurities and all.
lines.zh: 然后继续吸收这崭新的生活——连同其中的杂质。

{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
